mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at 66 degrees with overcast skies near Fireman's Park, and the moon is in its first quarter phase. If you are looking to the skies tonight, the International Space Station will make an appearance starting at 7:37 PM, rising from the direction of Cross Plains and traveling toward Madison.

City Hall has finalized the 2026 Comprehensive Plan, titled Envision Verona. This document acts as a long-term guide for local growth, housing, and infrastructure, based on feedback from hundreds of residents throughout the planning process.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness or join the crowd for Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival this Friday.

In our weekly police report, on September 5th, officers encountered a strange situation where multiple vehicles had cheese slices placed on their windshields near Main Street. No damage was caused, and it was identified as a viral social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is open today until 10:00 PM. Please note that the location is currently undergoing a remodel, so the flavor of the day is not available at this time.
